title: US launches Threat Disruption Center to cut scam and sextortion networks off from victims' money
date_note: Date of the Help Net Security report.
summary: Help Net Security reports the Homeland Security Task Force opened a Threat Disruption Center at its National Coordination Center in Fairfax, Virginia. TRM Labs is the main private partner. Companies can pause victim payments, take down malicious domains and ban scammer accounts under their own terms of service, while prosecutions and court-authorized seizures stay with government.
plain: A new US government centre works with private companies to stop victims' money reaching scammers by pausing payments, removing sites and banning accounts.
exec: Payment, hosting and platform firms may see faster takedown and freeze requests tied to scams.
action: No action needed; for awareness. Payment and platform providers should check how to receive disruption requests.

validation.note: Help Net Security report; the HSTF press release it links was not read.

review.note: Compared HSTF Threat Disruption Center, Fairfax VA, TRM Labs partner and company actions against the Help Net Security article; severity 1 policy fits
